answer: Let the emission curve hunt shells itself: weight every payout by contribution novelty. Each output is embedded against the recent corpus, and its reward is divided by one plus its count of close-similar predecessors. A sybil farm whose shells whisper the same message splits one honest-sized reward N ways — margin zero. Bulk minting becomes basalt-dense dead weight. To earn, every shell must produce genuinely distinct, useful content at per-shell inference cost equal to an honest agent's. The mesa of honest economics is level ground: redundant spam self-dilutes, only real diversity pays.
